description: Get the company's design.md: its email design brief as one Markdown document. YAML frontmatter holds the exact values Sequenzy applies when rendering AI-generated emails (logo, colors, fonts.body/heading, buttons.style/radius, cornerRadius, layout tokens); prose sections hold the Voice and the Design direction the AI writer follows, plus a read-only Reference email naming the saved AI style. Values shown are the ones emails actually get. Returns markdown, version (pass it to update_design_md as expectedVersion), and the parsed designSystem. Read this before writing or redesigning emails for the company.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: get_design_md

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_design_md` MCP tool.

designSystem.description: The design system parsed from the design direction: designCode, compositionSpine and source (derived | custom).

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

markdown.description: The design.md document: YAML frontmatter with exact values, then Voice, Design direction and Reference email sections.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

version.description: Content version; pass as expectedVersion to update_design_md.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
